known_issues: Cores da interface estão incompatíveis com as cores da fonte, prejudicando contraste/diferenciação visual.

existing_features.title: Adjust the global theme color tokens so that interface surface colors (backgrounds, cards, popovers, borders, accents) are clearly distinguishable from text colors and provide consistent, readable contrast in both light and dark mode.

Audit and update key layout components/pages that use hard-coded color utility classes so they consistently rely on the theme tokens (background/foreground/card/muted/accent) and do not reintroduce low-contrast text-on-surface combinations.

new_feature_requests.summary: Reajustar as cores da interface do app para evitar incompatibilidade/baixa distinção com as cores da fonte (garantir contraste e diferenciação)

projectName: Fix UI theme colors to ensure readable contrast between interface surfaces and text
